name: meet in the middle over a group by a table of small steps
mechanism: tabulate the first m powers of the generator, then step the target backward by multiples of m and look each value up in the table; a hit gives the exponent as a giant multiple plus a baby index, in about the square root of the group order steps

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Baby-step giant-step' in section Computational mathematics / Number theoretic algorithms:

fails_when: memory equal to the square root of the order
